name: while-were-here
description: WHILE WE'RE HERE — a print-first coffee-table book built with HTML, CSS and Vivliostyle.
author: Adam Hickey

scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n build,serve "node scripts/build.mjs --watch" "http-server build -p 4321 -c-1 -s"
scripts.preview: npm run build && vivliostyle preview build/book.html
scripts.pdf: npm run build && vivliostyle build build/book.html -o dist/while-were-here.pdf
scripts.pdf:press: npm run build && vivliostyle build build/book.html -o dist/while-were-here-press.pdf --preflight press-ready --preflight-option gray-scale=false --preflight-option pdfx=true
